messages.text: What is EVM, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

EVM is **Error Vector Magnitude**, a measurement of the difference between a reference waveform and a measured waveform; in base-station modulation-quality terms, it is the difference between ideal symbols after equalization and measured symbols, called the error vector [2][25]. RAW evidence also shows EVM as a product/specification term via “inherent error vector magnitude (inherent EVM)” alongside “frequency measurement uncertainty” [38].
| Product-related measurement decision | Why EVM understanding matters | Product-related context |
|---|---|---|
| **Pass/fail limits by modulation and tolerance** | NR EVM results must be below the 3GPP maximum error percentage, with modulation-specific limits such as QPSK 17.5% + TT, 64QAM 8% + TT, and 256QAM 3.5% + TT [1]. | In the 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance context, test case 6.4.2.1 is EVM PUCCH/PUSCH, the Test ID sets RB allocation and modulation scheme, and the DUT EVM must be confirmed within the specified range after configuration [2]. |
| **Max-power vs min-power EVM test setup** | The EVM test case requires measuring DUT EVM at both maximum and minimum power [2]. | CMX first sets maximum power automatically, and after max-power EVM verification the DUT must be set to minimum power using TPC Closed Loop settings [2]. |
| **Instrument/product specification interpretation** | Product specifications may expose “inherent EVM” and frequency measurement uncertainty as measurement-performance terms [38]. | For CMX500 NR FR1, the R&S CMX-KM600 option is required for any NR uplink TX tests, and its 5G NR analyzer condition lists EVM < 0.5% at 100 MHz bandwidth under specified FR1 conditions [7]. |
| **Generator/analyzer suitability for EVM-sensitive tests** | EVM must be understood to interpret whether the instrument’s own EVM performance is relevant to the DUT measurement [7][38]. | CMX500 specifications list 5G NR analyzer EVM < 0.5% for R&S CMX-KM600 under stated conditions, and 5G NR generator EVM < 0.5% for R&S CMX-KW601 under stated PDSCH conditions [7]. |
| **SRS measurement configuration** | CMX SRS RF measurements include TX Power, EVM, and more, so EVM is one of the measured SRS TX quantities [4][5]. | CMX supports regular SRS, SRS antenna switching, and SRS carrier switching; measurement is aware of SRS positions, and the user can select the SRS resource to measure [5]. |
| **FR2 OTA measurement direction** | For FR2 OTA, EVM is treated as a non-power measurement at TX beam peak direction [13]. | Slide-derived metrics list 6.4.2.2 EVM as measured “@ TX-BP,” and the chapter 6 beam peak is the TX beam peak, defined as the 100%-tile of the EIRP CDF, i.e. the strongest beam [14][17]. |
| **FR2 product measurement result and setting choices** | CMP200 NR FR2 multi-evaluation modulation results include EVM traces and single values [19]. | CMP200 NR FR2 settings include measured subframes per radio frame, measure slot, trigger source, trigger threshold, statistic count, and related measurement controls [19]. |
| **Production TX verification item selection** | A small-cell WMT production demo lists TX verification items including QPSK, ACLR, EVM, and SEM [22]. | The same demo context uses R&S PVT360A, RF cable TX measurement, and a 10 MHz reference from the PVT [23]. |
| **Base-station modulation-quality requirements** | Base-station modulation quality is defined as the difference between measured carrier signal and reference signal, and it can be represented by EVM [25]. | The listed EVM requirements are QPSK 18.5%, 16QAM 13.5%, 64QAM 9%, and 256QAM 4.5%, with SCPI queries for average EVM provided [25]. |
【推論】Understanding EVM affects product measurement decisions about **which limit to apply, which power condition to test, which SRS/FR2 OTA resource or direction to measure, and how to interpret instrument EVM specifications**, because the passages place EVM in those test limits, power procedures, SRS/FR2 contexts, and product specification terms [1][2][5][7][13][14][19][38].

passages.text:
EVM › 1C111 中的 5G NR EVM limits
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]，EVM measurement results 必須低於 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] Table 6.4.2.1.5-1 的 maximum error percentage，並套用 Table 6.4.2.1.5-2 定義的 Test Tolerance（TT）。來源摘錄的 Average EVM Level limits 為：

| Modulation | Average EVM level limit |
|---|---|
| Pi/2-BPSK | 30 + TT % |
| QPSK | 17.5 + TT % |
| 16 QAM | 12.5 + TT % |
| 64 QAM | 8 + TT % |
| 256 QAM | 3.5 + TT % |

TT 來源摘錄為：

| 條件 | TT |
|---|---|
| All except 256QAM | 0% |
| 256 QAM @ max power | 0.3% |
| 256 QAM @ min power | 1.1% |

來源範例：DUT on n78、100 MHz BW、PUCCH Test ID 1（QPSK）時，specified maximum EVM 為 **17.5 + 0 %**，且 CMX EVM measurement 位於 3GPP limits 內。

EVM › 來源定義
依 [[WIC Glossary]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- EVM 展開為 Error Vector Magnitude。

依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- Error Vector Magnitude（EVM）是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。
- 來源將 EVM 放在 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] test case **6.4.2.1 Error Vector Magnitude PUCCH/PUSCH**。
- Test ID 會設定 RB Allocation 與 modulation scheme。
- PUCCH subtests 需參考 application note chapter 2.1 notes。
- Apply configuration 後，需確認 measured DUT EVM 位於 specified range 內。
- Test case 要求在 DUT max power 與 min power 下量測 EVM。
- CMX 會先自動設定 max power；完成 max power EVM verification 後，DUT 需使用 TPC Closed Loop settings 設定為 min power。

[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 對同一 test case 的定義與限值摘要相同，並支撐既有 EVM 頁面內容。

EVM › 使用限制

EVM is **Error Vector Magnitude**, a measurement of the difference between a reference waveform and a measured waveform; in base-station modulation-quality terms, it is the difference between ideal symbols after equalization and measured symbols, called the error vector [2][25]. RAW evidence also shows EVM as a product/specification term via “inherent error vector magnitude (inherent EVM)” alongside “frequency measurement uncertainty” [38].
| Product-related measurement decision | Why EVM understanding matters | Product-related context |
|---|---|---|
| **Pass/fail limits by modulation and tolerance** | NR EVM results must be below the 3GPP maximum error percentage, with modulation-specific limits such as QPSK 17.5% + TT, 64QAM 8% + TT, and 256QAM 3.5% + TT [1]. | In the 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance context, test case 6.4.2.1 is EVM PUCCH/PUSCH, the Test ID sets RB allocation and modulation scheme, and the DUT EVM must be confirmed within the specified range after configuration [2]. |
| **Max-power vs min-power EVM test setup** | The EVM test case requires measuring DUT EVM at both maximum and minimum power [2]. | CMX first sets maximum power automatically, and after max-power EVM verification the DUT must be set to minimum power using TPC Closed Loop settings [2]. |
| **Instrument/product specification interpretation** | Product specifications may expose “inherent EVM” and frequency measurement uncertainty as measurement-performance terms [38]. | For CMX500 NR FR1, the R&S CMX-KM600 option is required for any NR uplink TX tests, and its 5G NR analyzer condition lists EVM < 0.5% at 100 MHz bandwidth under specified FR1 conditions [7]. |
| **Generator/analyzer suitability for EVM-sensitive tests** | EVM must be understood to interpret whether the instrument’s own EVM performance is relevant to the DUT measurement [7][38]. | CMX500 specifications list 5G NR analyzer EVM < 0.5% for R&S CMX-KM600 under stated conditions, and 5G NR generator EVM < 0.5% for R&S CMX-KW601 under stated PDSCH conditions [7]. |
| **SRS measurement configuration** | CMX SRS RF measurements include TX Power, EVM, and more, so EVM is one of the measured SRS TX quantities [4][5]. | CMX supports regular SRS, SRS antenna switching, and SRS carrier switching; measurement is aware of SRS positions, and the user can select the SRS resource to measure [5]. |
| **FR2 OTA measurement direction** | For FR2 OTA, EVM is treated as a non-power measurement at TX beam peak direction [13]. | Slide-derived metrics list 6.4.2.2 EVM as measured “@ TX-BP,” and the chapter 6 beam peak is the TX beam peak, defined as the 100%-tile of the EIRP CDF, i.e. the strongest beam [14][17]. |
| **FR2 product measurement result and setting choices** | CMP200 NR FR2 multi-evaluation modulation results include EVM traces and single values [19]. | CMP200 NR FR2 settings include measured subframes per radio frame, measure slot, trigger source, trigger threshold, statistic count, and related measurement controls [19]. |
| **Production TX verification item selection** | A small-cell WMT production demo lists TX verification items including QPSK, ACLR, EVM, and SEM [22]. | The same demo context uses R&S PVT360A, RF cable TX measurement, and a 10 MHz reference from the PVT [23]. |
| **Base-station modulation-quality requirements** | Base-station modulation quality is defined as the difference between measured carrier signal and reference signal, and it can be represented by EVM [25]. | The listed EVM requirements are QPSK 18.5%, 16QAM 13.5%, 64QAM 9%, and 256QAM 4.5%, with SCPI queries for average EVM provided [25]. |
【推論】Understanding EVM affects product measurement decisions about **which limit to apply, which power condition to test, which SRS/FR2 OTA resource or direction to measure, and how to interpret instrument EVM specifications**, because the passages place EVM in those test limits, power procedures, SRS/FR2 contexts, and product specification terms [1][2][5][7][13][14][19][38].

- 16QAM：13.5%。
- 64QAM：9%。
- 256QAM：4.5%。
